cards.name: Scarstech Prologue
cards.printed_text: There is nothing left. We are powerless. Their numbers stretch beyond sight, and their technology an incomprehensible nightmare surpasses everything we've ever known. With each passing moment, their core pulses with more energy, feeding them, making them stronger, while we wither. Our soldiers, broken and desperate, fight only to delay the inevitable, giving what little time they can to the terrified masses scrambling to hide. But even that is futile. The ships monstrous, unholy abominations are closing in. When they arrive, there will be no resistance, no salvation. This world, everything we loved, will be torn apart and consumed by these soulless machines. The Scarstech will inherit what remains, and all that was once ours will be ash in their wake.

callback_evidence.callback: function s.actop(e,tp) if e:GetLabel()~=1 then return end Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_SELECT); local g=Duel.SelectMatchingCard(tp,s.wlf,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,1,nil); local tc=g:GetFirst(); if not tc then return end local op=0; if tc:IsAbleToHand() and tc:IsAbleToGrave() then op=Duel.SelectOption(tp,1190,1191) elseif tc:IsAbleToGrave() then op=1 end if op==0 then Duel.SendtoHand(tc,nil,REASON_EFFECT); Duel.ConfirmCards(1-tp,tc) else Duel.SendtoGrave(tc,REASON_EFFECT) end end
callback_evidence.disposition: Add/send choice repaired

callback_evidence.callback: function s.actop(e,tp) if e:GetLabel()~=1 then return end Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_SELECT); local g=Duel.SelectMatchingCard(tp,s.wlf,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,1,nil); local tc=g:GetFirst(); if not tc then return end local op=0; if tc:IsAbleToHand() and tc:IsAbleToGrave() then op=Duel.SelectOption(tp,1190,1191) elseif tc:IsAbleToGrave() then op=1 end if op==0 then if Duel.SendtoHand(tc,nil,REASON_EFFECT)>0 and tc:IsLocation(LOCATION_HAND) and tc:IsControler(tp) then Duel.ConfirmCards(1-tp,tc) end else Duel.SendtoGrave(tc,REASON_EFFECT) end end

You can banish this card from your GY: Target 1 "Terrarumian" Spell/Trap in your GY, except "Terrarumian Growth"; Set it. You can only use 1 "Terrarumian Growth" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Fiendsmith's Soprana
cards.printed_text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Send 1 "Fiendsmith" monster from your Extra Deck to the GY, and if you do you can return to the hand 1 card from your opponent's field or GY. During your opponent's turn, if this card is in your hand or GY (Quick Effect): You can target 1 other LIGHT Fiend Monster Card in your Spell/Trap zone; Special Summon it, then if this card is in your hand, send this card to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Fiendsmith Soprana" once per turn.

cards.name: Fiendsmith's Offertorium
cards.printed_text: Special Summon 1 "Fiendsmith Engraver" from your hand or Deck, then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Link Summon 1 "Fiendsmith" monster using monsters you control, including a "Fiendsmith Engraver". If a LIGHT Fiend monster left the GY this turn: You can banish this card from your GY; Set 1 "Fiendsmith" trap from your Deck or banishment. You can only use each effect of "Fiendsmith's Offertorium" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you use either effect, except LIGHT Fiend monsters.

cards.name: Floowandereeze and the Hot Winds
cards.printed_text:
Apply 1 of these effects, or both in sequence if you control a Tribute Summoned Winged Beast monster.
• Place from your Deck or GY face-up on your field 1 "Floowandereeze" Field or Continuous Spell.
• Banish 1 monster from each field, including a Normal Summoned Winged Beast monster you control.
If this card is banished: You can banish 1 card from your hand; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Floowandereeze and the Hot Winds" once per turn.

cards.name: Floowandereeze and the Magnificent Sky
cards.printed_text: For the Tribute Summon of a "Floowandereeze" monster you can banish 1 monster from your hand or field and 1 "Floowandereeze" monster from your Deck (this is still treated as Tribute Summon). During the Main Phase, if you Tribute Summon a level 7 or higher Winged Beast monster: You can target 1 Defense Position monster your opponent controls; change it to Attack Position. You can only use each effect of "Floowandereeze and the Magnificent Sky" once per turn

cards.name: Floowandereeze and the Mythic Journey
cards.printed_text: Show 1 "Floowandereeze" monster in your hand, field or banishment; apply that monster's effect when it is Normal or Tribute Summoned, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot show monsters with that same name to activate "Floowandereeze and the Mythic Journey". If a face-up "Floowandereeze" Spell or a Level 7 or higher Winged Beast monster you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use this effect of "Floowandereeze and the Mythic Journey" once per turn.
